thread:
Marco: Heads-up — Product just confirmed GA for Gale-16b-slim on Mon. Expect a higher token/sec profile vs current 13B models. Need a quick capacity projection and deployment plan.
Alyssa: Do we have a prelim token/sec multiplier? last bench looked ~1.8x vs 13B for same prompt mix.
Tariq: +1.8x seems right for generation-heavy workloads. For chat-heavy with low context reuse it could be 2.1x.
Eva: Region note: EU-west has ~30% less available preemptible GPU capacity next week due to a partner maintenance window.
Marco: OK callout — we must avoid a canary that pins too much EU capacity. Can we route canary traffic to NA first?
Jamie: We can route 70% to NA, 30% to EU for canary. But NA autoscaler needs pre-warm to avoid cold-start latency.
Tariq: Suggested pre-warm: 20 dedicated A100s in NA for 12 hours before GA, then scale to baseline of 10 reserved. Estimated GPU-hours: pre-warm 240 GPUh, baseline 720 GPUh/day.
Alyssa: Cost rough numbers: spot A100 avg $2.8/hr, reserved effective $1.9/hr after commit. So pre-warm on spot ~ $672, baseline reserved ~ $1368/day.
Eva: Network constraints: EU peering has a 35 Gbps cap on the peering link we use for model weights cache sync. If we get heavy concurrent pulls during rollout we could see >300ms tail latencies. Need staggered deploys and cache seeding.
Marco: Good — add cache seeding step. Who owns the seed job?
Jamie: I'll own seeding. Plan: push weights to EU edge cache in batches of 50 hosts, 5-min separation. Script: 
```bash
for batch in $(seq 0 50 $HOSTS); do
  ssh batch-hosts "curl -sS $WEIGHT_URL | sha256sum" &
  sleep 300
done
```
Will monitor transfer QPS.
ops-oncall: Deploy-bot scheduled canary for 2023-11-06T09:00Z with rollout policy 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 2h. Be advised: auto-revert on 5xx spike >2%.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Jamie: gale-16b-slim v1 -> canary window 120m.
Tariq: If GA traffic rises as projected (1.8–2.1x), our sustained token/s across fleet increases ~90–110%. That translates to ~1.9x GPU-hours short-term. Need to confirm committed reserved pools or we'll burn expensive burst spot.
Alyssa: Quick ask to Finance: can we increase committed monthly GPU hours by 25% for Nov? Otherwise cost delta moves to variable budget.
Marco: @Finance (cc Alyssa) please review. Also ops: add autoscaler overrides to prefer reserved over spot when sustained CPU utilization >60% to reduce preemption.
Eva: I'll add autoscaler rule: prefer reserved instances after 30m of sustained 60% utilization; hysteresis 10m.
Jamie: Monitoring checklist: token/s dashboards, per-region KV cache hit rate, weight-pull latencies, 95/99 latency, 5xx rates. I'll create an alert runbook.
ops-oncall: I'll standby for first 4 hours of GA and coordinate rollbacks. If EU peering hits 80% link utilization, we pause EU ramp.
Marco: Summary action items: 1) Jamie seed EU cache + runbook, 2) Tariq pre-warm NA 20 A100s 12h, 3) Eva update autoscaler rule, 4) Finance decision on +25% committed hours, 5) Ops oncall covers GA window.
Alyssa: I'll update the capacity forecast doc with GPUh/day and cost delta and tag product + finance.
Marco: Thanks all — post any last-minute blockers here. :thumbsup:
